summary: ADB recovery scripts resolve their helpers from the active Tier0 release instead of the git checkout (ClawMobile f70df9e parity).
root_cause: ClawMobile/samantha f70df9e (2026-10-02) was never carried into samantha-core: adb-recovery-watchdog.sh, adb-recovery-supervisor.sh and adb-recovery-readiness.py still called ~/ClawMobile/installer/termux-lite/*, so a checkout change could bypass Tier0 promotion and rollback. Found by the ClawMobile vs samantha-core parity audit of 10/10.
architecture: No new component. RUNTIME_DIR = CLAW_RUNTIME_ROOT or the script's own directory, as the other termux-lite scripts already do; ADB_RECOVERY_READINESS_HELPER override kept.
rollback: tier0-control rollback to the previous last-known-good release.
